subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS app persist a desired Launch at login preference and reconcile launchd after Sparkle updates, or should the UI continue to reflect only the live launchd registration state?
rationale: Both shapes are plausible, and the safe fix depends on maintainer intent for macOS startup semantics, Sparkle update behavior, and whether LaunchAgent remains the right mechanism versus a newer login-item API.

options.title: Persist desired autostart state
options.body: Store the user’s desired Launch at login setting, reconcile the LaunchAgent after app/update startup, and surface repair errors without silently removing the plist.

options.title: Keep launchd as source of truth
options.body: Treat the toggle as a live status indicator only, document that unloaded launchd means off, and close this after confirming current behavior is intentional.

options.title: Redesign around login-item APIs
options.body: Move this to a broader macOS startup design using ServiceManagement or SMAppService instead of extending the current LaunchAgent path.

recommendation.title: Persist desired autostart state
recommendation.body: Store the user’s desired Launch at login setting, reconcile the LaunchAgent after app/update startup, and surface repair errors without silently removing the plist.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue was recently mentioned by steipete, and the history shows prior launch-at-login merge ownership plus broader macOS app work.
